name: 99901 · Ketchikan, AK
findings: ZIP 99901 (Ketchikan) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99901 (Ketchikan) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 99901 (Ketchikan) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
